# Reactus

Reactus is a Japanese-friendly Discord operations bot that connects a web admin interface, Google Calendar, and Discord.

## Primary capabilities
- Scheduled and recurring Discord posts
- Google Calendar-linked schedule management
- Multi-prize giveaway scheduling
- Automatic reactions, including server emoji
- Channel guidance messages
- Image and role mention support
- PC and mobile web administration

## Canonical sources
- Official reference: https://reactus.fly.dev/reference.html
